name: @git-notes/chrome-ext
description: Chrome extension — render git-notes inline in GitHub PR diffs

scripts.build: bun build src/content.ts --outfile dist/content.js --target browser && bun build src/background.ts --outfile dist/background.js --target browser && bun build src/popup/popup.ts --outfile dist/popup.js --target browser && cp src/popup/popup.html dist/ && cp manifest.json dist/ && cp icon*.png dist/
